title: How Shaytan Spreads His Anger
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah w'Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd.
Whole glory, whole honors, whole majesty only for You, our Lord, our Creator. Thanks to You from preEternal to Eternal. O our Lord, forgive us, we are weak servants! O our Lord, for your most honored one,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s), forgive us yaa Rabbee, yaa Rabbee! Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee,
forgive us, we are weak! Give us Your heavenly support! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
O Listeners! As-salaamu `alaykum. We are (listeners), because even some or handful of people may listen to
grants of heavens coming down. O our Lord! We are so weak ones. For the honor of your most honored one
through Your Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) give us much
more ability, capacity for keeping Your orders, keeping Your most high respect. Your respected one, most
honored one though Your Divine Presence, for his honor we hope, O our Lord, for Your Mercy Oceans. Even
one spot may clean ourselves in a second or less time measure. You can do everything, You are Lord. You are
our Creator. Everything from You, it is pleasure for us. Every addressing through Your holy book, Holy
Qur'an, it is an endless respect, endless pleasure, endless majesty spots running like rains, raining on
ourselves, O our Lord!

Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Every addressing giving to Your servants endless honor! Allah, Allah! We are keeping or not, but that honor
is such a big grant, no one can imagine. To make good servants in His Heavenly Presence and to speak and to
address to Him endless honor, endless honor.
O our Salafi `ulamas! Once upon a time you are very zidi, serious ones, you never smile at anyone, you are
always very angry with people, particularly those who you are saying about them sometimes 'mushriq,' and
you are saying sometimes, 'kafir.' If anyone looking at you, they are fearing from your bad characteristics!
One question we may ask, laa hawla wa laa quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem. One important question
and I am asking to those who thinking they are most important ones, Salafi `ulama. Never laughing or
smiling, always looking to people with anger. Why are you looking to people so angry? Who created you,
created ourselves also. Why you are angry with creatures? He is happy and we are laughing, yes. He is our
Creator, our Lord, but you are always looking to us with anger.
O our Listeners! As-salaamu `alaykum. You know that no one can claim, "I am a powerful one,” and if
someone saying, "I am an important one,” and he likes to be an important one.
O People! Who created ourselves making us to be sometimes crying, sometimes smiling, sometimes
laughing? Yes? Like Abdur Ra`uf, sometimes very angry looking, sometimes smiling, he is happy. (laughter)
Once upon a time he had a car and another car coming on him, that time, he forgot smiling, laughing, he was
so angry, swearing on people, yes. What you are saying, that the Lord of Heavens, Allah (swt)... (Mawlana
Shaykh stands.) We can stand up. The angels laughing through Your Divine Presence, never getting tiring,
never shikwa, complaining, they are happy to be in front of their Lord! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Yaa Sayyidi, yaa Sultan al-Awliya, we are asking support of our qutb, who is looking after everything for every
moment, through oceans, through continents. Who granted someone for His servants such a power? That
power in our vision is so big, but for the Lord of Heavens, laa uzkar, never mentioned. Allah, Allah.

And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ’r-rajeem, because so many people following satanic
teachings.
I am asking to Salafi `ulamas a question. If they may say to me that is Shaytan any time smiling or laughing?
Answer? No answer. "No," I may say. He is always in anger, and anger belongs to fire. Because he had been
created from fire, never knowing to be happy with people. Always anger surrounding him, from the time that
Allah Almighty ordering to angels, "Bow to Adam," his anger just appeared. From that day up to today,
Shaytan never getting to be smiling or laughing or to say, "I am happy." Always he is in anger and anger is
from fire. But anger's fire does not belong to his fire, that is created. Therefore, he is angry one by creation
and after holy command of Allah Almighty, ordering to bow to Adam, his fire under ashes, just open and
zhahir, flames appeared. It was under ashes and when that command coming, "Bow to Adam!" then suddenly
opening and suddenly flames running from north to south, from east to west, covering this Creation.
Therefore, now from that time up to end, up to the Day of Resurrection, that flames of Iblees, Shaytan, never
coming down, but getting more and more and he was thinking that he was happy. When whole people falling
through his flames and burning, he is going to be so happy. Yes, from that time, not from inside, but he is
Shaytan, going to be happy and not smiling, but laughing when he was looking at people through flames,
burning. He is getting full happy and not smiling, but laughing. That is his mission. "I shall burn Mankind on
this dunya. I am not leaving them to be happy, never to be happy. And I shall use all my possibility and effort
for burning Mankind." He was swearing, swearing. Therefore, from that time he began to make people to cry,
not to laugh. And he is doing countless disease, countless tricks and countless traps for Mankind to make
them always in Sorrow Oceans.
And now he is saying that, "O, I reached top point of my target. O the Lord of Creation, You are looking and
seeing that You granted to me to be free up to Day of Resurrection and I am doing with Your servants and I
am making Man not to be happy, not to be enjoyful, and not to be joyful nor in happiness. Look, my Lord,
look!" Saying one angel, yusubuku, swearing at Shaytan, FFFEEE "SHUT UP, DIRTY ONE!" Heavenly arrow
reaching to him, one angel. Shaytan saying, “I did to your servants not to be happy through their whole lives
on Earth, I did it." And that angel saying, "SHUT UP, DIRTY ONE!" and from that haybat, greatness from
that angel shouting, he falls down and for 40 years he can’t move! O our Lord! Forgive us and make us not to

fall down into Shaytan's traps!
And after that, Shaytan not smiling or speaking anything. So that one after sultans, after kings, after
emperors, who just falling in a Misery Ocean or they are falling in Suffering Oceans, that you can’t find now
on Earth one person to be happy! All of them just falling through darkness of miseries, through troubles, that
no one can bring any solution for Mankind's troubles now. Finished. Man, now they forget to laugh and they
forget also smiling. When they forget smilings, Shaytan is taking his head and looking east and west and
saying, "O my beloved ones, O my followers, I am taking you to a plain that you should be there, happy,
happy, happy." What we can do? Shaytan's deputies saying to his real followers like Stalin, like Lenin, like
Hitler, like Mussolini, like Franco, like Castro, like Mao, yes. Making them, saying to them, "Get up! Wake
up! Now it is time for you! Do everything! I am giving to you all that I have. What I can't do with my hands, I
am giving my hands to you. And what I am thinking to do from badness and from oppression, I am granting
to you to do that!"
Each one of them just slaughtered and killed hundreds of millions of people from French Revolution up to
today, killing millions of people, killing good ones, not bad ones, good ones, so that whole world going to be
under their control. And as saying the Seal of Prophets (s) `ahd al-jabaabirah (Period of Tyrants):
•••• •••••• ••••••••
wa min ba`di 'l-mulooki jabaabiratun, “After kings, and sultans, and padishahs, and emperors, coming
soldiers.”
And Shaytan saying, “I am sending certified doctors from my academy to do every evil and dirtiness and
oppressions from Mankind.”
Only from the time of French Revolution up to today, in 200 years perhaps 500 milllion people just killed, no
doubt, no doubt! Now people they are looking themselves, “What you are doing? How we can save ourselves?
What is coming on us?"
And Allah looking and saying, “Your Lord's command was, ‘Be My servants and follow true ones. That’s what
I am saying to you. Be sadiq, good ones.” But you left to be good ones, coming to be bad ones, and troubles
coming on you! Countless troubles, countless killings, countless dirty people making their worst for nations,
killing and doing every badness because people following them and refusing to follow Allah Almighty's

chosen ones! He said, “O People! follow true ones." And you leaving that and following Shaytan's
representatives everywhere, even here!
A big lesson for nations, but yet they are insisting to follow them. Fighting to sultans, fighting to kings, and
they are taking bad ones with them and they are doing bad things, oppression, burning, destroying, killing,
and doing every badness and then they are saying through TV's or radio or computer, saying through east
and west, “We are best ones.” But they are worst ones and making declaration, “We are best for you.” No they
are not best one! Sultans did their best, kings did their best for servants of their Lord, but now you are doing
your best for Shaytan!
Countries now happy and in pleasure? No. But throwing stones like this, like this, then getting to be
underground, finished, passed away, everywhere troubles, crises, never-ending…. (Transmission cut near end
of broadcast.)
Fatihah.
